domestic_evidence: Company is a listed Indian pharma manufacturer with an active domestic formulations business evidenced by NPPA/DPCO price-compliance notices published on its own investor site: "In compliance with Order S.O. 6001(E) dated 2nd November 2026 issued by the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority ... the ceiling price of the scheduled formulation Oxaliplatin Injection 5 mg/mL in 10 mL vial (1 vial) has been fixed/revised at ₹2285.84 (exclusive of GST). Accordingly, RPG LIFE SCIENCES LTD. has reduced the MRP of the products." and "In compliance with Order S.O. 5690(E) dated 17th October 2026 ... trade margin on specified non-scheduled anti-cancer medicines has been capped at 30%. Accordingly, RPG LIFE SCIENCES LTD. has reduced the MRP of the products." MRP/ceiling-price compliance under DPCO applies to products sold in the Indian domestic market, which is direct evidence of domestic supply activity. Site also states portfolio "reaches 80+ countries". GST turnover band: not retrieved (screener.in returned HTTP 404 for both /company/RPGL/ and /company/RPGL/consolidated/); exact domestic-vs-export revenue split not read from the annual report PDF within the tool budget — null.
note: Legal entity exists and is active: RPG Life Sciences Limited, an RPG Group company, listed on Indian exchanges, registered office CEAT Mahal, 463 Annie Besant Road, Worli, Mumbai (per ImportKey record header). Role: manufacturer (own API + formulations plants; exports own branded/generic products and APIs) — not a trader. Declared HS codes 293329/293339/293359 are heterocyclic-compound API headings and are broadly consistent with observed export lines 29339990, 29334990 and 29333990 (all within the 2933/2934 API family); however the company also ships finished formulations under 3004 (e.g. 30049032 Tricaine MPS to Nepal), so the declared HS set is incomplete rather than wrong — recommend adding 3004 codes. Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code, not merely claimed. Domestic supply is confirmed by DPCO/NPPA MRP-compliance actions on India-market products. Revenue and export-volume figures: null — not read from a primary filing within the tool budget; do not treat the 2437 shipment count as a volume figure. No sanctions/court/insolvency issues were examined (out of scope for this role). No rejection grounds found.
